description: Late patches (applied after the sea mesh is built): harbours whose water areas the sea graph does not reach: each link is a straight line over open water (checked against the OSM land polygons) from the harbour's own water network to the nearest node of the sea graph. Vila Real de Santo António: the Guadiana mouth (159 m). Saltsjöbaden: Baggensfjärden to Ingaröfjärden (1.3 km). Göteborg: the Göta älv mouth below the Älvsborg bridge (340 m).
